package.name: teleop_core
package.description: Pure C++ logic around operator teleoperation: an AUTO / TELEOP / HOLD mode manager with an explicit transition table, a jog shaper (deadband, expo curve, scaling, axis mask, slew limit, watchdog, frame selection) and a jog limiter (safety speed scale, stop, fail-safe on a stale scale). Eigen only, no rclcpp, no clock, no I/O. Builds and tests with ROS not sourced. No node wraps it yet.
